errors.text: The proposed 22–41 GPa, near-room-temperature treatment does not reconstruct the essential 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2-hour HPHT treatment.
The hypothesis substitutes an FCC-to-HCP transformation derived from CoCrFeMnNi evidence for the target's formation of a coherent hierarchical FCC/B2 patterned structure.
The stated alloy, AlCoCrFeNi2.1, and as-cast initial condition do not match the target Al0.7CoCrFeNi homogenized alloy.
The HIP comparison changes both pressure and temperature relative to the proposed high-pressure treatment, so it cannot isolate the effect of extreme pressure.
No evidence establishes that the FCC-to-HCP transition, HCP retention, or improved interface toughness occurs in this Al-Co-Cr-Fe-Ni eutectic alloy.
